verdict.rationale: Data residency is a fair question for a framework that also offers a hosted Mastra Cloud, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows that Mastra uses storage for workflow state and memory, and that apps can run locally or deploy to Mastra Cloud, Vercel, Netlify or Cloudflare. Nothing documents choosing a storage region or residency. Self-hosting or picking a host platform is a host-platform or user-side arrangement, not a product residency control, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
